purpose: Preserve and map every original acceptance bullet from issues #27/#28/#30/#33/#32 to stable local acceptance IDs, plan stages and required evidence. This file is a planning artifact, not observed passing coverage or issue completion.
stable_id_policy: IDs identify immutable original issue bullets in snapshot order. They are not test-registry behavior/case IDs and must not be renumbered when implementation is split. Actual registry bindings remain pending rather than invented.
mapping_rules: original_text preserves every acceptance bullet verbatim, excluding only the Markdown '- ' list marker.
Historical issue context stays historical. Current source observations do not rewrite original conditions or establish acceptance.
Required evidence classes and plan stages describe obligations, never observed execution outcomes.
All required Linux/macOS/Windows semantic and effect observations remain obligations; unknown applicability is pending rather than automatically skipped.
Native/Wasm each execute independently and backend-pair compares their applicable raw observations.
Performance is required on fixed native arm64 macOS and native arm64 Linux VM profiles. Windows timing is diagnostic and not a performance claim.
Pinned upstream profiles require immutable image/executable identity, tool versions and source/distribution checksums; PATH availability or mutable labels do not establish parity.

An API boundary needs original condition, unfinished observable behavior, classification, precise API/platform, minimal reproduction, rejection effects, canonical ADR/support, responsible child and exact unlock.
Selected algorithms/options and failed performance gates cannot be transferred to children to manufacture completion.
Source/package/contract/backend-pair/upstream/published/resource/performance evidence remain distinct. No current source inspection or historical report marks a row complete.
Release acceptance requires exact changed-package coordinates, full actual-main gates and exact RC/formal MoonX consumers. This map does not authorize publication.
No issue was filed, closed or commented. Ordered closure remains #27 -> #28 -> #30 -> #33 -> #32 after formal exact-consumer and final-main acceptance.

evidence_class_definitions.source-review: Pure-MoonBit implementation, released public APIs, exact source/dependency ownership and hotspot review.
evidence_class_definitions.package: Registered package regression execution and independent algorithm/vector/property checks as applicable.
evidence_class_definitions.contract: Raw stdout/stderr/status/input/effect assertions bound to stable registered cases.
evidence_class_definitions.backend-pair: Independent Native/Wasm executions compared using applicable raw observations.
evidence_class_definitions.upstream-differential: Current command observations compared with an immutable pinned upstream profile.
evidence_class_definitions.published-differential: Actual exact RC/formal MoonX consumer observations compared with applicable frozen contracts/oracle expectations.
evidence_class_definitions.boundary: Minimal public-API/platform reproduction, exact rejection effects, canonical ADR/support and responsible child/unlock mapping.
evidence_class_definitions.resource-observation: First output, RSS/explicit memory/temp disk/handles/children/filter/index peaks and cleanup/failure effects.
evidence_class_definitions.performance-observation: Frozen per-row real-MoonX timing/ratio/size/raw-sample/statistical gates; not semantic compatibility.
evidence_class_definitions.release-provenance: Candidate/RC/formal coordinates, archive/resolution identities and exact checked-out/main/consumer execution receipts.

evidence_taxonomy_note: These are obligation categories for this acceptance map. They do not extend or substitute the repository registry's executable required_evidence enum.
